regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked Non-Participating Group Term Insurance Plan
key_benefits: One-year renewable group term life cover for members of Employer-Employee (EE) and Non-Employer-Employee (NEE) groups
Death Benefit (Sum Assured) on death of the member, payable as lump sum or partly lump sum and remainder in instalments over a chosen period
Joint Life cover for self and spouse — death benefit payable on first death of either
Optional profit sharing for the group based on experience rating (applied as a reduction in next year's renewal premium), if opted
Free Cover Limit (FCL) offered per Board Approved Underwriting Policy (BAUP)
riders_available: Bajaj Life Group Accidental Death Benefit Rider
Bajaj Life Group Accidental Permanent Total/Partial Disability Benefit Rider
Bajaj Life Group Accelerated Critical Illness Benefit Rider
Bajaj Life Group New Terminal Illness Rider
Bajaj Life Group Critical Illness Rider

eligibility.policy_term: One-year renewable group term contract (annual renewal date).
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Yearly / half-yearly / quarterly / monthly; one-year renewable.
eligibility.note: Cover terminates at age 70 for NEE schemes and age 80 for EE schemes (older member under joint life). Numeric entry-age and sum-assured limits not stated in the parse; sum assured is per justifiable factor and BAUP. Verify against the policy document.

key_terms.free_look_note: 30 days from receipt of the policy document (electronic or otherwise), to review terms — except where the policy tenure is less than a year. Refund of premium less proportionate risk premium and expenses; processed within 7 days.
key_terms.grace_period: No grace period for yearly mode. 30 days for all frequencies other than monthly; 15 days for monthly.
key_terms.suicide_clause: Applies ONLY to NEE schemes where membership is not compulsory: on death by suicide within 12 months of commencement of membership, the contract is terminated by paying 80% of the premium paid for that member (in force). Not applicable to EE schemes or to NEE schemes where membership is compulsory. There are no other exclusions.
key_terms.maturity_benefit: No maturity benefit under this plan.
key_terms.surrender_benefit: No surrender value under this plan; on surrender no new members may be enrolled and existing members continue to be covered (on payment of due premiums).
key_terms.loan: No policy loan available under this plan.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits as per applicable tax laws. GST per prevailing tax laws — subject to change.

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a one-year renewable PURE-RISK group term plan — cover is for one year at a time and the insurer may renew or decline renewal per BAUP; premiums and terms are reviewable yearly.
Profit sharing is OPTIONAL and experience-rated (minimum 1,000 life-years covered) and is delivered only as a reduction in the next renewal premium — not a cash bonus or payout to members.
Joint Life cover is limited to self and spouse and pays on first death only.
The suicide-payout (80% of premium) clause applies only to NEE schemes with non-compulsory membership.
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT position as a savings, investment or wealth product — there is NO maturity benefit and NO surrender value; it is pure-risk group term protection.
Do NOT use 'guaranteed returns', 'maturity amount', 'money-back' or 'bonus' language — non-linked, non-participating; 'profit sharing' is a renewal-premium reduction, not a bonus to members.
Do NOT imply a loan can be taken — no policy loan is available.
Do NOT imply lifelong/permanent cover — it is annually renewable and terminates at age 70 (NEE) / 80 (EE).
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — carry the 'as per applicable tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked Non-Participating Group Term Insurance Plan'
Standard disclaimer to read the policy document (and policy exclusions) for full terms and exclusions

gaps: Numeric entry-age and sum-assured boundaries not stated in the brochure (left to BAUP / justifiable factor); only the termination ages (70 NEE / 80 EE) are explicit. Parser's NAME-field UIN (116B005V06) is a rider UIN; the plan N-UIN per the contact-details page is 116N021V08.
